name: JSON to CSV
summary: Convert a JSON array of objects into CSV with headers — in your browser.
description: Paste a JSON array of objects (or arrays) and get downloadable CSV. Headers are collected from object keys in first-seen order. Commas and quotes are escaped correctly.

faqs.question: What JSON shape is required?
faqs.answer: An array of objects, or an array of arrays. A single object is not enough — wrap it in [ ].

faqs.question: What if rows have different keys?
faqs.answer: All keys across rows are unioned into the header. Missing values become empty cells.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
